lane: H77G: Hydrothermal Magnetite-Destruction Trough x Gravity-Basement Step x MT Clay-Cap Margin (HMDT-GBS)
assignment_irregularity: No separate single-method paragraph was supplied in the 2026-10-21 prompt (same class as IR-77-06, IR-78-01, IR-H77E-01, IR-XSEN-01); lane H77G was self-declared and preregistered before Experiment 1 (IR-77G-01).
single_method_paragraph: From SHA-256-pinned training_features.tif only (zero SGMC inputs, zero prior submission rasters, zero catalogue inputs in the feature stack): compute high-pass reduced-to-pole magnetic anomaly (RTP minus sigma=12 px Gaussian regional) and extract multi-scale positive Hessian ridge curvature of inverted -RTP_hp at sigma=1.5 px and 3.0 px to isolate narrow linear hydrothermal magnetite-destruction troughs; pair this demagnetization-trough persistence with oriented gravity-basement normal-fault step concordance (geometric mean of |grad iso_grav_anom| and |grad depth_to_base_surf| gated by cosine alignment of their dip-normal gradients and gravity-over-magnetic analytic-signal decoupling), magnetotelluric smectite clay-cap lateral margin (geometric mean of cond_surf and |grad cond_surf|), geodetic transtensional opening index (dilatation x shear strain rate), declustered independent earthquake swarm fraction (ieq / (ieq + deq)), and basement-depth Hessian saddle curvature. Validate all 10 channels via single-feature ROC-AUC leakage canaries (<= 0.90) and dual-seed whole-component buffered hide-and-recover holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, seeds 20 and 30, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel, B=37,654 dots emitted via 300 m submodular cover > 3 px from visible faults), check pre-placement surface and final-dot uniqueness against the registry, and write a single-band float32 GeoTIFF in [0,1] with nodata=None via the unmodified vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py.
hypothesis: Ascending hydrothermal fluids (150-250 C) along blind Great Basin fault conduits alter ferrimagnetic titanomagnetite to paramagnetic pyrite, leucoxene, and smectite clay, creating a linear short-wavelength RTP magnetic trough (negative curvature valley) that coincides with an intact subsurface gravity-basement density step, an electrically conductive MT clay-cap margin, and regional transtensional strain.
named_non_fault_mimicking_process: Non-tectonic paleo-channels incised into Tertiary volcanic bedrock and filled with non-magnetic lacustrine diatomite or felsic ash-flow tuff against a buried bedrock buttress unconformity, or reversed-polarity volcanic flow boundaries.
